# mabinogi-007 — establishment log (2026-11-12)

Evans 1907 cols 55 l. 6 – 61 l. 18 (PDF pp. 60–63). Every column read on the page image (zoom 6, four crops per
column; zoom 12 for single lines). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation and paragraph shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r;
ſ → s; raised letters into the line; line-end marks, Evans's dotted and wavy underlines (col 55 "urenhin", col 56
"a'y", col 58 "ade-", col 59 "dydgueith", "maryf"), the "!" after "uab" (col 57 l. 1), the tie under "yneuad uawr"
(col 59 l. 8) and the stroke before "yna" (col 57 l. 22) dropped.

Tooling note: crops cut from a full-page render (PyMuPDF via python3.13). Odd pages (61, 63) have the columns
at x ≈ 5–125 / 125–232 pt, even pages (60) at 95–210 / 208–322 and (62) at 110–224 / 219–332.

The archive.org OCR file for this part (source/drafts/mabinogi-007-ocr.txt) is damaged at col 56: after line 2
it carries a block of mabinogi-006's established text and repeats line 2; and col 56 l. 25 is jumbled. Col 56
was read entirely from the image.

## Opening
- col 55 l. 6 — "Ac yna guedy daruot" begins mid-line after "y'r mab."; no large initial.
- Close: col 61 l. 18 "… benn pedwarugeint mlyned." The Third Branch's large G follows (next part).

## Worklist items (30 check + 27 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the witness agrees with the image (r-rotunda, w for 6, ss for ſſ, minim
clusters, dropped letters): col 55 ll. 9 (kyrchawd), 10, 12 (Nyssyen, Eurosswyd), 26, 29 (want y mab); col 56
ll. 6, 19, 25 (whole line: "y Gwydyl. A dyuot deu Wydel uonllwm idaw a'y uwrw yn y peir yn rith Gwydel"),
27, 28; col 57 ll. 15, 17, 18, 21 (drwod), 27 (a wnaethant), 34, 36 (ker-det); col 58 ll. 3 (llyma), 11, 15,
22, 23, 25; col 59 ll. 2, 13, 16 (gewssynt), 24, 28 (Uendigeiduran); col 60 ll. 8, 21, 24; col 61 l. 9.

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 56 l. 5 — **"Guern gwngwch uiwch Uordwyt Tyllyon"**: Evans spaces "gwngwch uiwch" (witness "gwn, gwchuiwch";
  Red Book also "g6ng6ch ui6ch"). Division as Evans; the sense of the cry is obscure — for the drafter's note.
- col 57 l. 31 — **"guae ni o'm ganedigaeth"**: Evans prints *ni* plainly (zoom 12); witness and Red Book *ui*.
  Kept as printed; the note to say the Red Book reads *ui* 'woe is me', and that *ni* 'woe to us' does not sit
  with *o'm* 'of my'.
- col 60 l. 13 — **"namyn kychu a'r penn"**: Evans *kychu* (no r), certain on the image. Witness *kyrchu*; Red Book
  *kychwynnu ar penn*. Kept as printed (a slip, for *kyrchu* or a shortened *kychwynu*); note, uncertain.
- col 61 l. 18 — **"ac ar Yspydaut Benn"**: Evans *ar* (witness *am*); the Red Book also reads *ar*. Kept.

Raised (inserted) letters:
- col 58 l. 29 — **"o uwyt"**: *u* raised over the *w* after *o* ("ŏ6ẏt") — into the line (witness agrees).

Scribal slip kept as printed, for the drafter's note:
- col 58 l. 36 – col 59 l. 1 — **"Ac ar hynny o gin— A chyn amlyket …"**: col 58 (the last line of fol. 185v,
  footer "Folio Clxxxv") ends "Ac ar hỳnnỳ o gin"; col 59 opens "A chyn amlyket oed udunt wy a chyn bydynt gyt ac
  wy. Ac ar hynny o ginyaw y buant seith mlyned." The scribe began the next sentence too early, broke off, and wrote
  it again in its place; not a catchword (the next leaf does not begin with these words). The Red Book has it
  once. Printed as written, the broken word marked with a dash; the note to say so.

Witness supplements not supplied:
- col 58 l. 30 — witness "Ac y [gyt ac y] dechreuyssant": not in Evans; the sense does not need it.
- col 59 ll. 31–33 — witness puts "Yspydawt Uranwen a Matholwch oed yr honn yd aethpwyt e Iwerdon" in braces;
  Evans prints it as running text, so it stands as text (an aside: the note to say so).

Layout, no text missing:
- col 55 ll. 11–13 — indented short lines and a space in "kyn ny bei [space] urenhin".
- col 56 l. 13 — scribe's blank in "tranoeth [blank] y bore".
- col 57 l. 30 — short indented line "unt. Oy a uab".
- col 60 l. 30 — short line "un kyfnot a".

## Word division and punctuation (ours)
- "yneuad uawr" (col 59) kept one word as in 001, 004, 005 ("yneuadeu", "Y'r yneuad", "yneuad").
- "ymywn gogof" (col 60) divided "y mywn" (as in 002–006).
- "yglan Alaw" (col 57) divided "y glan", following 006's "y gwaelawt"; the note to explain *yg* + nasal mutation
  of *glan* (yng nglan). Same open point as 006's (QUESTIONS.md).
- "ymlith" kept one word (witness). "Gliuieu. eil taran" → "Gliuieu Eil Taran". "Sef seithwyr a dienghis:" colon.
- Witness's misplaced comma-and-quote after "Tyllyon" corrected to a full stop inside the speech.
- No words supplied.
